newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - PaineWebber reiterates Questar.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PaineWebber reiterates Questar.

text.p: - PaineWebber analyst Ron Barone has reiterated his buy recommendation on Questar Corp and has a 12 month price target of $43 for the stock, which was at 35-1/4 by 1142 EST.

- He believes that Questar should be trading at a 10 percent premium to its peer group instead of a current seven percent discount and is forecasting $2.50 earnings per share for 1997 compared with $2.23 in 1996. ((-- New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
